sources.label: Morphe patches for Bejeweled Classic
sources.author: 6jarjar6
patch_list: [Experimental] Ad-free
Removes ads. Rewarded ads still grant their reward without playing.
[Experimental] Crash-guard
Null-guards the GluAnalytics callback references (fixes latent NPEs).
[Experimental] Cross-promo-button-text
Replaces the in-game "GET STARS!" cross-promo button label (a Nimble OBB string, all locales) with "GitHub" (same length per locale, no size change).
[Experimental] Cross-promo-redirect
Redirects the GET STARS! cross-promo button to the GitHub repo (instead of promoting EA’s game).
[Experimental] Network-cut
Removes android.permission.INTERNET, disabling the network entirely (fail-closed). All telemetry and ads are structurally severed.
[Experimental] Telemetry-disabled
Stops Nimble/Synergy, Firebase, GLUAnalytics (incl. privacy flags), Facebook/Unity, popcap, and IronSource mediation telemetry.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Google Daydream, Nova Launcher and Bejeweled Classic
sources.author: Patapon888
patch_list: Change app name
Renames the app from "Classic" in the launcher.
Classic mode layout
Arranges the game modes in the main menu like the original iPad version. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Disable Play Games sign-in
Stops the game from signing in to Google Play Games and showing its pop-up at launch.
Disable tracking
Removes the game's network access, which also removes the data consent pop-up, and turns off analytics.
Fix Diamond Mine background
Stops the Diamond Mine wood background from being stretched on wide screens. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Fix text formatting
Fixes texts that skip a word or show "(null)", such as the title of a won badge. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Hide profile id
Removes the EA account number shown after the player name in the records. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Language setting
Adds a language choice in Android settings (Apps > Bejeweled > Language, Android 13+). Restart the game after changing it.
Remove boosters

Removes the paid boosts from every mode, the Diamond Mine "use a time boost and continue" offer and the "no more moves, use a mixer" offer. The hint stays, centered in the tray. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Remove Play Games buttons
Hides the Google Play Games buttons from the menus. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Remove purchases and ads
Removes ads, the store, promotional pop-ups and the paid continue offers after a game over.
Unlock game modes
Unlocks Poker, Lightning and Butterflies, removing their limited free plays. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
